title: The Warning Note
description: A dimly lit desk scene viewed from over the shoulder of a person in a green jacket. An open wooden drawer reveals a black flashlight, a set of keys, a red string, a coin, and a handwritten note that reads 'If the painting appears, do not follow alone.'
